caption: A drop of water lands on a phone screen, and the tiny pixels under the drop appear magnified.

sa.check: A drop of water lands on a phone screen.
The pixels under the drop appear magnified.
The drop lands first and the magnified pixels are seen after.

pc.expect: The enlarged pattern shows only within the drop and would move if the drop slid.
pc.fail: Pixels outside the drop are enlarged; or the drop shows nothing different; or the enlarged patch is offset from the drop.

pc.expect: The screen itself is unchanged; the magnified pattern is its own pixels.
pc.fail: The screen's picture changes; or a different pattern appears in the drop; or the drop shows a mirror image.

pc.expect: The drop is a rounded bead of liquid.
pc.fail: It is a rigid lens; or it spreads flat and thin instantly; or it bounces.

pc.expect: The drop lands and sits on the screen.
pc.fail: It hangs above the screen; or rises; or slides uphill.
The drop duplicates; or the phone vanishes; or the drop passes through the screen.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The phone and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The phone changes; or the table changes; or the screen colours shift.
